_doc: Storyboard keyframes v2 (visual spec v2, 2026-10-01): one idiom per scene, PAPER/INK/CLAY grounds. Only reference image = reference/clawd/clawd-canonical.png (Clawd). Rendered into out/storyboard/v2/. For communication only; never used as assets.
style: Storyboard keyframe for a music video, 16:9 (1920x1080). Shared grammar: a strict Swiss typographic system (Archivo-like bold grotesk that can be cropped by the frame, a mono font for machine text, thin hairline rules, asymmetric grid layouts, generous negative space); a strict palette of only three colours: warm paper #F2EFE9, deep ink blue #1B2A4A (never black) and clay orange #D77757, plus red #C8453B / green #3F8F5F ONLY for failing/passing test marks and code diff lines. Depth may come from fine engraving-style hatching lines and atmospheric haze, never from photorealistic lighting, reflections, lens flares or gradients. Only clay-orange elements may glow, and only on the ink-blue ground. The world is kinetic, precise, graphic and premium; not cartoon: no outlines, no stickers, no mascot-style world. The only character is exactly the flat 16x5 pixel sprite in the reference image (orange body, two dark square eyes, arms sticking out at both sides, four one-pixel legs), drawn with crisp square pixels, small in frame, never 3D, never redesigned. A small clay-orange block text cursor is a recurring motif.

frames.prompt: GROUND: deep ink blue. Near darkness; a faint drafting grid recedes in perspective with atmospheric haze; a single glowing clay-orange block cursor blinks in the middle. A bordered welcome box is being drawn in thin paper-coloured hairlines, stroke by stroke: '✻ Welcome to Claude Code' / 'cwd: ~/calendar'. Inside it the pixel sprite lights up pixel by pixel, eyes closed. Quiet, anticipation.

GROUND: split moment of a hard flip from ink blue to paper. The left third is still ink blue, the rest has flipped to paper on the beat; a notification card 'Issue #1031 · calendar' snaps in; the word 'PING' as huge cropped grotesk type slams across the flip line. The sprite has one eye open.

GROUND: paper. Bureaucratic paper idiom: the issue is an official form with typed fields, a form number, checkboxes and hairline boxes; title field 'Calendar shows October 32'; a big clay rubber stamp 'BUG' has just slammed onto it at an angle with rough ink texture; a small calendar thumbnail with a hand-drawn clay circle around '32'. Slight camera shake feel.

GROUND: paper. A 3D city made of the October calendar: each day cell is extruded into a block building with fine engraving hatching on its sides, day numbers printed on the roofs; the camera flies low along the street of days 1 to 31; at the end, block '32' is rising out of the ground; the clay cursor draws a thin route line along the street. The sprite stands at the base of block 32.

GROUND: ink blue. Side-scrolling platform idiom: lines of monospace code are platforms on three parallax depth layers, paper-coloured; a file tree unfolds as a paper-line blueprint (src / calendar / month.ts) in the background; the sprite crab-walks along a code line, lines it has read light up in clay.

GROUND: paper. A checklist being drawn live by the clay cursor acting as a pen plotter with single-stroke lettering: '☑ Read the code' struck through, '☑ Write a plan' struck through, and a big check stroke being drawn on '☐ Fix October' right now; huge cropped grotesk 'CHECK' behind. The sprite hops.

GROUND: ink blue. The keyboard is a 3D landscape of keycaps with engraving hatching, a wave rolling through it; the camera dives steeply toward the Enter key, which becomes a glowing clay cursor at the end of the dive (match cut). The sprite rides the wave.

GROUND: CLAY flood. The hook impact: the entire frame has flooded clay orange on the sung accent; giant paper-coloured grotesk 'COMMIT' slams in, cropped by the frame; a commit hash 'a1f3c9e · fix: calendar loop' bursts in ink mono type; brackets ( ) { } [ ] snapping into pairs; the sprite mid-jump (drawn in ink so it reads on clay).

GROUND: ink blue. The test runner as an oscilloscope: a paper-coloured scan line traced by the glowing clay cursor with fading phosphor-like echoes, one dot per beat, a mono label 'npm test' and 'running 19 tests…'; drafting grid behind. The sprite watches, tense.

GROUND: paper. Nineteen thin glass-like slabs standing in a row in 3D, each carrying a failing test name with a red cross; they are shattering into flat angular shards on the beat, shards drawn with hatching; counter '19 failed' in red mono. The sprite jitters in panic.

GROUND: ink blue. A typographic storm with depth: thousands of paper-coloured monospace lines ('at daysIn (month.ts:42)') falling diagonally on three depth layers, the far ones hazy and soft, the near ones sharp; a giant word 'undefined' crashes down in grotesk type; the sprite is tiny below, arms up.

GROUND: paper. The same terminal command 'npm test' repeated as a stack of photocopies, each copy more degraded (xerox noise, skew, toner streaks), the last one mostly red marks; in the foreground huge counting numerals 1 2 3 … 10 11 set in grotesk with varying widths, the '11' in clay; the sprite with eyes closed counting on its legs.

GROUND: CLAY and ink split. Hook impact level 2: half of the frame is a clay flood with a giant 'COMMIT' slam, the other half an ink-blue git log waterfall of endless commits 'fix', 'fix', 'fix a bit' scrolling up; two panels 'local ✓' (green) and 'CI ✗' (red) colliding in the centre; the sprite flung out between them.

GROUND: deep ink blue. An infinite vertical shaft of stacked call-stack frames seen from above, falling away into haze: 'render()', 'buildMonth()', 'daysIn()' as hairline technical drawings with floor numbers; parallax drafting grid and vertical motion streaks; the clay cursor falls like a plumb line with the tiny sprite; at the very bottom one line glows clay.

GROUND: ink blue, about to flash to paper. The '≤' symbol as a monumental 3D engraved sculpture (dense engraving hatching, like a banknote vignette), filling the frame like a landscape; the tiny sprite stands on its lower bar and snips it off with an extended arm; a small caption 'line 42: for (let d = 0; d <= days; d++)'.

GROUND: paper. Nineteen test slabs falling like dominoes in 3D with engraving hatching, each turning from red cross to green check as it falls, accelerating along a curve; counter '19/19 passed' in green; huge cropped grotesk 'GREEN'. The sprite jumps.

GROUND: clay flood turning to paper. Hook impact level 3, the biggest: the one-character diff enormous: '- d <= days' in red and '+ d < days' in green, set huge; the clay cursor draws the merge line of a hairline git graph joining the main line; far behind, dozens of flat devices arranged in a 16x5 grid form the giant pixel sprite shape. Triumphant.

GROUND: ink blue night fading to paper at the right edge. All of the day's commits are joined into a delicate hairline constellation of clay points across the dark sky; a small calendar flips 'Oct 31' to 'Nov 1'; at the dawn edge a notification slides in: 'Issue #1032'. The sprite asleep, eyes closed. Quiet, circular ending.
